name: Bazaar
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Bazaar brings the Omarchy plugin marketplace to your bar. Search names, descriptions, tags, and authors; filter by category or kind; rank trending by views per day since listing; and flag listings whose marketplace record has no install command. Save a private local shortlist, see listings added since your last visit, open a listing or repo, copy a safe CLI command, or install from a validated GitHub URL. Catalog refreshes every six hours and stats every 30 minutes. No account data is ever sent.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when new plugins are listed. Off by default, because a marketplace is something you browse when you choose to, not something that should interrupt you.

schema.label: Default sort
schema.description: Trending is views per day since a plugin was listed. Hearts, installs and views are cumulative totals, so they rank long-listed plugins above genuinely popular new ones.

schema.label: Count new listings on the pill
schema.description: Show how many plugins have been listed since you last opened the panel. Turn off to keep the pill as a plain icon.

schema.label: Flag listings without an install command
schema.description: Marks a listing when the marketplace explicitly says no install command is available, so you know it requires manual setup before opening it.
